messages.author: 083bcb1dff09d004
messages.subject: CNA spike-in simulated data
parts:
Hi,

I've recently joined the group. Does anyone know if the simulated CNA data(e.g. DG1136a) is available or if there's a relatively easy way to generate one using existing simulating tools.

Thanks,
Soroush

messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: CNA spike-in simulated data
parts:
HI Soroush,

The spike-in simulation data for DG1136a are not available. The method of how it was generated is described in the Supplementary Methods.  The simulation was generated at the stage prior to TITAN analysis such that the spike-in events were added to the TITAN input files.  

However, the ovarian sub clone mixture samples are generated by computationally mixing reads from BAM files to generate mixture BAM files.  These mixture BAMs are available on EGA under study EGAS00001000547 and Dataset ID EGAD00001000974. Please request permissions from the BC Cancer Agency (BCCA) Data Access Committee by contacting Sarah Jane Lee (TDOadmin[at]phsa.ca).

Hope this helps,
Gavin
